verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents some bulk-style operations. Its HTTP Tracking API has a batch endpoint that submits multiple events in one request, and its syncs push many modeled rows to destinations in a single run, with CDC sending only added, changed, or removed rows. Git Sync lets users manage workspace resources programmatically, which could support changes across many resources. However, nothing documents bulk actions across many workspace items at once, such as triggering, pausing, or editing many syncs or audiences in one call or from the UI. Missing for 10: documented bulk actions across many resources (syncs, models, audiences) via the API, MCP server, or UI; evidence that Git Sync supports multi-resource changes; independent or hands-on corroboration.
